basic_info.description: This charming 1-bed/1-bath condo is ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers, investors, or as a pied--terre. Located on a quiet tree-lined street in SF's fabled Pacific Heights neighborhood, it's just steps from recently refurbished Lafayette Parkfeaturing a playground, tennis courts, dog area, and scenic picnic area. Easily get to a plethora of options for fine dining, boutique shopping, and trendy cafes in nearby Cow Hollow's Union St, Nob Hill's Polk St, and the Marina's Chestnut St. The home is move-in ready with fresh paint, new carpet and recently updated dual-paned windows. Inside, you'll find a spacious living/dining room with bay window and pleasant north-facing outlooks. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, generous cabinet storage, and ample counter space. The serene bedroom also boasts a bay window with great light, while the full bath offers a shower-over-tub. Additional perks include in-unit laundry, 1-car garage parking, and separate additional storage. The well-maintained building includes a fitness center and a rooftop deck with iconic views of the Bay and city lights. Walk Score: 96, Transit Score: 86.
